policy.name: confidence_aware
policy.rule: Preserve supported/neutral/mixed decisions; demote a contradiction to insufficient_evidence only when its strongest contradiction confidence is below the development-set threshold. Never use a threshold to promote an uncertain case to supported.

strategy_comparison.selection_criterion: highest development accuracy, then macro-F1, then fewer windows per claim, then fixed strategy order

limitations: The 26-case development set is manually extracted from the small corpus, is not a random sample, and gives only a rough threshold estimate.
Softmax scores are not calibrated probabilities; the threshold is a model-confidence cutoff, not a guarantee that a claim is true.
A confidence threshold cannot repair high-confidence false contradictions caused by citation irrelevance or domain mismatch.
The fixed benchmark has only 33 cases, so differences of one case should not be treated as reliable population estimates.
Citation validation and backend failure handling are evaluated separately from NLI confidence.
